scope: Four changed and one unchanged tool projected from a seven-tool observation. The source digests identify the original seven-tool lists.

before.name: cheapest_window
before.description: Rank Home+ action windows by household cost. Experimental carbon/balanced modes use a disclosed trailing historical production-mix profile—not a forward carbon forecast—and support no emissions-reduction claim.

objective.description: Ranking objective (default cost). Carbon/balanced are experimental historical-profile heuristics, not forward carbon forecasts.

tariff.description: Optional variable household bill inputs; fixed monthly charges are excluded.

before.name: get_forecast
before.description: Probabilistic price forecast (P50 curve; P10/P90 on Pro+) up to 7 days ahead. Home and grandfathered Free keys are scoped to their selected zone. Accuracy published daily at voltcast.com/accuracy.

before.name: get_prices
before.description: Day-ahead electricity prices in each zone's native currency and native market resolution. Requires an API key; Home starts at voltcast.com/register?plan=home.

before.name: get_renewables
before.description: Day-ahead wind + solar generation forecasts: the TSO's official forecast AND Voltcast's own model (volt-res-1) with q10-q90 bands, beside realized generation, with head-to-head verification (who beats whom, disclosed). Pro/Scale.

before.name: list_zones
before.description: List all supported European bidding zones with codes, names, and capabilities. No auth required.

current.name: cheapest_window
current.description: Rank household action windows by cost using current Voltcast curves and optional user-supplied variable tariff inputs. Experimental carbon/balanced modes use a disclosed trailing historical production-mix profile—not a forward carbon forecast—and support no emissions-reduction claim.

objective.description: Ranking objective (default cost). Carbon/balanced are experimental historical-profile heuristics, not forward carbon forecasts.

tariff.description: Optional variable household bill inputs; fixed monthly charges are excluded.

current.name: get_forecast
current.description: Probabilistic price forecast up to 7 days ahead. Returns the P50 curve and any uncertainty bands included in the connected account. Accuracy is published daily at voltcast.com/accuracy.

current.name: get_prices
current.description: Day-ahead electricity prices in each zone's native currency and native market resolution. Connect an existing Voltcast account to access account-scoped data.

current.name: get_renewables
current.description: Day-ahead wind and solar generation forecasts: the TSO official forecast and Voltcast model with uncertainty bands, realized generation, and disclosed head-to-head verification. Requires the corresponding existing account entitlement.

current.name: list_zones
current.description: List all supported European bidding zones with codes, names, and capabilities. No auth required.
